# Getting help

| Need | Where |
|---|---|
| Questions, setup help, support for the hosted instance | [Discord server](https://discord.gg/DDBGWP5fMX) |
| Something is broken | [Bug report](https://github.com/haxurus/Dispatch/issues/new/choose) |
| An idea or improvement | [Feature request](https://github.com/haxurus/Dispatch/issues/new/choose) |
| A security vulnerability | [Private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/haxurus/Dispatch/security/advisories/new) |
| Privacy and data requests | haxurus@icloud.com — see the [privacy policy](https://dispatch.haxurus.com/en/legal#privacy) |

Before asking, these usually answer the question:

- [README](../README.md): features, how it works, Discord application setup.
- [Ticket protections](../docs/TICKET_PROTECTIONS.md), [forms](../docs/FORMS.md) and [panels](../docs/PANELS.md).
- [Deployment guide](../docs/DEPLOYMENT.md) and [distribution rules](../docs/DISTRIBUTION.md) for self-hosted instances.
- The server's ticket log channel (Dashboard → Logs) records opens, claims, closes and delivery problems, which explains most unexpected behaviour.

Support is provided on a best-effort basis. Self-hosted instances are supported through the Discord server and GitHub issues, as time allows.
